problem: The v0.1 runtime persists one evidence vector for every assertion and open-tracklet comparison. Candidate A synthetic density qualification proved exact N*(N-1)/2 negative-evidence growth; the current real-source shape implies at least 26,629,672,948 first-occurrence comparison vectors.

alternatives.approach: Retain exhaustive traversal but physically compress or hash every legacy evidence vector.
alternatives.reason: Can reduce bytes but cannot remove quadratic traversal or logical evidence cardinality; therefore it does not resolve the proved blocker.

alternatives.approach: Persist only pair vectors for competitors that satisfy a candidate-specific necessary retrieval key and replace exhaustive impossible-competitor vectors with one deterministic negative-coverage certificate per candidate observation.
Use indexes to find potential positives but reconstruct every skipped negative vector before final output.
alternatives.reason: Restores quadratic work during evidence reconstruction and therefore fails the scaling objective.

C2P2-PS0-OP-A-STRICT-CONTINUITY-v2.proof_basis: same_geometry_signature is a required conjunct of same_object_pair_supported

C2P2-PS0-OP-B-RELATIONAL-CONTINUITY-v2.proof_basis: same_relation_topology and owner_declared_geometry_compatible are required conjuncts; owner compatibility requires source-kind and owner-geometry-class equality

C2P2-PS0-OP-C-EPISODE-ENRICHED-CONTINUIT.proof_basis: owner_declared_geometry_compatible is a required conjunct; the frozen dependency registry is empty and the C2E disposition remains NOT_APPLICABLE_C2_ONLY

coverage_certificate_contract.claim: Every competitor omitted from pair evaluation failed at least one frozen necessary predicate by construction of the index key, or all competitors were blocked by a current-observation discontinuity/terminal-break predicate.
coverage_certificate_contract.auditability: Deterministic replay can reconstruct and verify index membership, totals and candidate terminal outcomes without materialising one JSON record per impossible pair.

ObjectAssertion IDs, observation counts and latest material
intentionally_versioned_delta: negative evidence vectors are not individually materialised
match decision evidence_vector_ids contain only evaluated necessary-key competitors
legacy decision_id is therefore not an equivalence target

complexity_target.negative_evidence_storage: O(N) certificates instead of O(N^2) impossible-pair vectors
complexity_target.candidate_A_all_unique_geometry_expected: O(N log N) traversal and O(N) evidence certificates with zero pair vectors
complexity_target.discontinuity_note: Censoring open tracklets remains proportional to affected open state at each explicit discontinuity; qualification must measure this separately and must not disguise it as pair-evidence work.

required_qualification: A/B/C bounded exact-reference terminal and lifecycle equivalence
